common.appSubtitle: Village and ward civic problem reporting, verified repair tracking, and transparent public accountability.

landing.heroTitle: Report local issues. Track real fixes.
landing.heroSubtitle: A community-first platform connecting residents of Gram Panchayats and municipal wards with verified civic resolutions. Every repair requires independent verification before closure.
landing.step1Desc: Upload a photo of damaged roads, water leaks, or waste. Select your village and ward, or pick a pin on the map.
landing.step2Desc: Panchayat reviewers inspect the issue, link possible duplicates, and route to the correct team with clear priority.
landing.step3Desc: Field workers perform the repair and must submit photographic evidence of completed work.
landing.step4Desc: An authorized reviewer independently confirms the fix before status is marked 'Resolved'. Citizens can dispute if unresolved.
landing.disclaimer: GramaSeva is not an emergency dispatch service. AI suggestions are advisory only and require human review.

notices.advisoryAi: AI suggestions are advisory only. Official decisions are verified by authorized local officers.
notices.privacyGuaranteed: Your personal contact details and private coordinates are never shared publicly.
